page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz with a single thread per core, paired with 64.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 7 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. Single-core CPU performance, measured via stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression is in the bottom 10%. However, multi-core CPU execution, Passmark CPU scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reach average tiers. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, though the overall Passmark memory score remains in the lower 25%.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density, the instance offers stable performance for multi-threaded workloads. It is suitable for static web serving, Redis database operations, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks. The absence of local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient option for workloads that rely on network-attached storage and do not require hardware acceleration.
